title: saxifraga mutata subsp. demissa
intro: Saxifraga mutata subsp. demissa, commonly known as the "Mountain saxifrage" or "Alpine saxifrage", is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Saxifragaceae family. This plant is native to the alpine regions of Europe and Asia and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Saxifraga mutata subsp. demissa include its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids.
